name: QSB-PTQ-v0

paper_inspiration.citation: E. Ozyilkan, S. M. Sriramu, E. Erkip, A. B. Wagner, and J. Balle, SoftBinary Coding, arXiv:2606.29578v1, ICML 2026
borrowed_ideas_only: communication by binary channel simulation rather than deterministic scalar quantization
shared randomness and a polarized binary transform
separation of training mutual information from operational serialized length
not_claimed: This package is not the paper's implementation or topology.
No theorem from the paper establishes finite-block rate optimality for this package.
The stage-0 mutual-information oracle is not a serialized channel-simulation result.
No paper Gaussian or TCQ curve is imported as evidence.

objective.source_energy_denominator: all authenticated values in the scored expert fold

panel.stage0_dominance_oracle_scope: all six experts; score-fit per-matrix decoder is deliberately source-leaking and may not be reported as held-out performance
panel.future_training_rule: fit only on fit experts, choose frozen restart on calibration expert, evaluate closed score experts once

architecture.family: post-training stochastic-binary channel simulation with a nonlinear interaction decoder

encoder.block_normalization: subtract block mean and divide by sqrt(centered_mean_square + 2^-24)
encoder.logits: alpha_cell times a frozen 160x64 signed projection divided by sqrt(64)
encoder.prior: factorized Bernoulli marginal estimated on fit experts only
encoder.alpha_selection: 48-step deterministic bisection on fit experts only to target 97% of the cell's payload reservoir in ideal KL bits

shared_randomness.operational_selection: one seed chosen on calibration and serialized; stage-0 oracle grants the best seed separately for every matrix

decoder.bias_scale_and_output: Q15 bias and a serialized power-of-two per-matrix scale; widen the integer result to binary64 and apply the scale exactly for scoring, with no output cast in the experiment
decoder.stage0_oracle: unquantized FP64 intercept and 64x256 decoder fitted separately on each scored matrix, with the best of all three frozen shared-randomness seeds
decoder.dominance: the exact binary64 reconstruction of the operational shared Q7 affine decoder and its one selected seed is a member of the per-matrix FP64/best-seed oracle family; any deployment cast is outside this experiment and cannot be used to reverse a kill

distinct_from_additive_vq: There is no stored vector dictionary and no nearest-codeword index search.
The bit string is an output of source-conditioned Bernoulli channels reproduced by shared-randomness channel simulation.
Ninety-six multiplicative bit interactions make the decoder non-additive in latent bits.
No reconstruction is a sum of independently selected codebook vectors or residual stages.
The exponentially large reconstruction set is implicit in one shared finite decoder.

channel_simulation.stage0_grant: ideal communication at exact empirical sum KL with zero finite-block, probability-table, framing, or entropy-coder overhead
channel_simulation.future_operational_transform: 18-level seeded permuted binary polar transform on each 2^18-channel segment
channel_simulation.future_message: XOR correction between source-conditioned and source-free polarized draws, compressed with one frozen integer range coder
channel_simulation.future_decoder: recover correction, reconstruct polarized bits with shared randomness, invert transform, apply finite decoder
channel_simulation.reservoir_rule: the actual prefix-framed message must fit the fixed expert payload reservoir; overflow rejects the cell and all unused bytes are zero padded and charged
channel_simulation.no_rate_claim: KL is an optimistic stage-0 rate oracle, not physical bpw; only a byte-emitted and independently decoded stage may report operational rate

prepass: hold, hash, BF16-decode and finite-check all 18 plan sources exactly once
compute source energies before scoring and authenticate canonical Gate/Up/Down-transposed geometry
estimate each cell alpha and Bernoulli prior from fit experts only
stage0_protocol.rate_gate: kill a cell if ideal expected KL for any expert exceeds 97% of that expert's fixed payload reservoir; no asymptotic theorem may waive overflow
stage0_protocol.dominance_oracle: for every matrix and each frozen common-randomness seed, form 256 decoder features, fit the minimum-SSE FP64 decoder on that same matrix, and retain the best seed
stage0_protocol.early_control_gate: rate overflow kills before any decoder oracle; the frozen favorable-oracle upper-three-SE gate kills before controls; no raw-SSE shortcut may bypass the frozen uncertainty rule
stage0_protocol.aggregate_gate: hard-kill before controls when aggregate capture plus three delete-expert jackknife SE is below the cell's exact required capture
stage0_protocol.hard_kill_scope: only the exact QSB-PTQ-v0 topology, three seeds, feature map, panel, and physical cell
stage0_protocol.survival: an oracle survivor is not compression evidence and only authorizes matched controls and a separately audited operational implementation

matched_gaussian_controls.construction: independent FP64 Gaussian values per matrix, then affine recenter/rescale to match that matrix's empirical mean and centered energy; the runner rejects mean error above max(2^-45, RMS*2^-40) or centered-energy relative error above 2^-40
matched_gaussian_controls.identical_effort: repeat fit-only alpha/prior selection, all three common-randomness seeds, and the same per-matrix source-fit oracle
matched_gaussian_controls.execution_order: controls run only for cells that survive the dominance aggregate gate
matched_gaussian_controls.promotion_gate: Qwen delete-expert lower-three-SE source-specific gain must exceed the strongest control upper-three-SE; every expert and role fold must be positive
matched_gaussian_controls.interpretation: diagnostic source-structure comparison only; the source-fit oracle can overfit and is not an operational Gaussian codec

comparison_semantics.matched_gaussian_stage0: empirical algorithm control using the same optimistic oracle; not operational and not a lower bound
comparison_semantics.future_operational_gaussian: must emit and decode the exact QSB container on Gaussian controls before any operational claim
comparison_semantics.future_operational_tcq: must use an independently implemented finite-state TCQ, emit its actual bytes, charge its own model/framing/padding, and report its measured rate; paper plots or textbook points are context only
comparison_semantics.shannon_gaussian_mse_limit: D_G(R)=sigma^2*2^(-2R) is an asymptotic information-theoretic lower bound for a memoryless Gaussian source under MSE; it emits no bytes and is neither TCQ nor an empirical control
forbidden_claims: Do not call a stage-0 oracle operational.
Do not call TCQ the Shannon limit.
Do not infer a Qwen win from a Gaussian or TCQ calibration.
Do not claim to beat Shannon from finite-sample oracle SSE.
Do not transfer the paper's Gaussian result to Qwen weights.

future_operational_requirements: freeze and audit the exact integer polar transform, range coder, Q7 decoder and common-randomness generator
create the output container at an absent path and independently decode bytes only
reject any expert reservoir overflow and charge all padding
require absolute F upper confidence bound <= 0.8 on closed score experts
require source advantage over every matched control and positive expert/role folds
verify exact physical bpw and cold read from emitted byte offsets
obtain separate authorization before any fresh-validation or one-shot pinned execution

authority.next_action: independent source audit, then coordinated RunPod stage-0 only
